description: This Java class defines a size validator for 'thing' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It ensures that the command size does not exceed a configurable maximum limit and provides singleton access to the validator instance.

classes.name: ThingCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: Validator class for checking the size of 'thing' commands against a maximum allowed size, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the size validator, initializing it based on a system property if necessary.
